1,16,83,930 Ordinary Shares held by Rujuvalika Investments Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Steel Limited w.e.f May 8, 2015), do not carry any voting rights.
Tata AIA Life Insurance Company Limited is not considered part of Promoter Group holds 20,11,792 Ordinary Shares representing 0.02% of the paid-up Ordinary Share Capital. Accordingly, holding of Tata AIA Life insurance Company Ltd. is included under Public Shareholding under the head Instutitions-Insurance Companies.


Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited is not considered part of Promoter Group holds 23,20,000 Ordinary Shares representing 0.02% of the paid-up Ordinary Share Capital. Accordingly, holding of Tata AIG General Insurance Company Ltd. is included under Public Shareholding under the head Instutitions-Insurance Companies.
During the quarter ended June 30, 2018, the two Promoter Group Companies - Sir Ratan Tata Trust and Sir Dorabji Tata Trust had sold their entire holdings in Tata Steel Limited.
Tata Sons Private Limited (TSPL) holds 32.46% in Tata Steel Limited as on September 30, 2022 and Tata Steel Limited is an associate of TSPL. TSPL being a Core Investment Company registered with RBI, is exempted under the Significant Beneficial Ownership (SBO) Rules. The Company does not have any other Significant Beneficial Owner under SBO Rules to be reported in the shareholding pattern as on September 30, 2022.


Tata Capital Financial Services Limited (TCFSL), a subsidiary of Tata Capital Limited, was allotted fully paid-up equity shares of Tata Steel Limited pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Tata Steel BSL Limited into and with Tata Steel Limited on November 23, 2021.
